panels.text: A hero finds a legendary sword. Only ONE hero can hold it at a time.
The hero hands it to a friend. Now the friend owns it, and the hero's hands are empty!
In Rust this is a move: let b = a; The value goes to b, and a can no longer use it.
When the owner leaves (goes out of scope), the sword is cleaned up automatically. No leaks!

puzzle.question: Which line breaks the rules?
puzzle.hint: Who is holding the sword after line 2?
puzzle.explanation: After line 2, the sword moved from a to b. Line 3 tries to use a, which no longer owns anything.

apprentice.name: Pip
checklist: Every value has exactly one owner
Assigning or passing a value moves ownership
The old owner can't use it after a move
When the owner goes out of scope, the value is freed
clone() makes a real copy if you need two
